notes.title: An update to myPOPGOES is out... rejoice! (v1.1)
notes.notes:
[b]An update to myPOPGOES is out... rejoice![/b]

myPOPGOES has been updated on Steam with a few important changes. This is not the reprogrammed version of the game. I'll tell you what is included! 

Additions:
 - Very subtle hints have been added to the game to help with naturally discovering the secret ending.

Bug fixes:
 - If the game recognises that you've completed a level (with a star or in-game achievement) but you didn't get an achievement on Steam... it will now be granted on Steam when you boot the game up! We've tested this with some of YOUR save files, and it has worked so far. Let me know if this works for you guys!
 - Wrongfish will no longer sometimes spawn perfectly on top of a Rightfish (which would make it impossible to clear the current level) in Fishing.
 - The bar used to represent the pizza expiration in the Expiring Pizzas challenge is now more visually reliable (it would previously pause for too long on the final frame).
 - The Character Bios menu no longer bugs out when you toggle zoom (no more random Spanish, or faint spoilers...).
 - Some menus have been reworked to load faster or fix minor visual errors.

Balance changes:
 - Topping Juggle now gives points when you trash utensils.
 - The pizzas in Expiring Pizzas now expire at a slightly slower rate.
 - Endless mode thresholds have been lowered from 7pm, 8pm, and 9pm... to 6:45pm, 7:30pm, and 8:15pm. This is a temporary adjustment and we plan on implementing a better approach in the reprogrammed version of the game. But please feel free to give this mode another go if you found the original version too frustrating - it is not cheating! Previous high scores remain, so if you hit 9pm you can still brag about it.

That's it at the moment! I know there are other issues that people are running into, but a lot of those things (like the game simply not acknowledging that you've beaten a level at all) may need to wait until the full reprogram of the game (which we are making progress on). If you run into NEW major issues in this build, let us know and we will prioritise them.

If this update fixes the issues that you have with the game, I'd really appreciate you leaving a review that reflects that on Steam. But it's up to you, and we do have more work to sort out! Thanks for your patience.

 - Kane
